data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Specify caller-update strategy. Run caller inventory grep as FIRST sub-step; record results in task comment. Decision rule: atomic-update if <=3 non-test callers; shim-with-deprecation otherwise. If shim chosen, add explicit follow-up task to remove it. Update all identified non-test call sites in same commit as rewrite. Rationale: avoids type-mismatch at runtime for non-test callers when shim path is dead code (state/file conflict).
